page.layout: One printed title page, centred, with a woodcut or engraving in the lower middle and manuscript and stamp marks around it, which are not transcribed.
page.notes: The title is faded and partly obscured by show-through from the reverse. Many lines in the middle and lower part cannot be read with confidence, so they are marked illegible rather than guessed. The Latin "NATVRALIS", "adiuncta" and "PHILOSOPHIÆ" are fairly clear, and the red-printed words are hard to separate from the black. The woodcut or engraving (a tree-like or emblematic device) and the handwritten and stamped marks (the "Collegii" stamp, the manuscript "Gomalin"-type words, and the round library stamp at the left) are not printed text and are omitted. The imprint line at the foot is too faint to read.
